reviewer: current assistant, actual visual inspection; not human or physical calibration
findings: The head image now contains the full bottle from its top opening to its bottom in all five inspected stages.
During grasp and release, fingers naturally occlude parts of the vessel; these occlusions are present in stored RGB and were not filled or edited.
Head, left-wrist and right-wrist views are distinct; the right-wrist view follows the active right hand, and the left-wrist view remains consistent with the inactive left side.
Both wrist images at all five selected frames are pixel-identical to the earlier v1 capture; head RGB changes as expected from the new runtime optical pitch.
limitations: Camera transforms remain simulation runtime presets, not measured physical D435 calibration.
Geometric field-of-view inclusion does not imply the object is unoccluded by fingers.
Only the minimum empty-bottle task and its actual SDK24 replay are validated; this is not an autonomous screw-cap or tablet-pouring demonstration.
Visual quality review concerns these five stored stages; all 1167 RGB frames were separately decoded and all389 head-frame target projections checked.
